why: Post-snapshot papers prove Beilinson-type conjectures for narrow cases (K3 surfaces with an involution, Feb 2025; abelian surfaces conditional on BSD, Sep 2025; a function-field analogue, May 2025), but it is unclear whether these count as cases of the general conjecture stated by Wikipedia or as work on a related/derivative conjecture (Beilinson-Bloch) in a restricted setting.
